name: Hayakawa Makoto
source:
Commander of the 11th Special Walking Armour Training Battalion.

The protagonist of this story.

Known as a “hero” among Armour pilots, because three years ago, during the great battle, he was one of the seven pilots to take the world’s first Walking Weapons into actual combat.

(At that time, he was the only pilot who was not a head of one of the Rokukyō Families.)

Even now, he continues to travel between training duties and the battlefield with Kotetsu, the very first prototype unit.

Having grown up in a military environment from as early as he can remember, he is poor at dealing with women outside the battlefield.

“For the sake of the Imperial State, I would not hesitate to lay down my life.”

[From [url=http://tech-gj.jp/products/hyakki/chara/index.html#hayakawa]official website[/url]]
